after.name: BSP_HardwareLayoutRecord_Initialize
after.evidence: Actual native 44h owner / 0Ch records. Ordered base/record initialization, preserve COM/token; append count publication before target read, pointer publication before retain/current-profile release, temporary unwind cleanup without catch maps; current signed stride count and DWORD wrap.  Original ABI: ECX actual 0Ch record; EAX same address; RET. Complete src/native_hardware_layout_fields.cpp; reports/native_hardware_layout_fields_audit.json. 23 live/PE spans 1147 bytes (383 owned), 31 declared patches/postimages, four actual primary-library providers; seven comparisons 6540 DWORDs, native FH3 search1/unwind1, both second-failure children exit91 with identical terminal state. Fixed record constructor cannot throw on valid storage: constructor failure maps audited only. Existing shared_ptr interface preserved separately. Strict Win32 and two existing CTests passed; no native ABI/game proof.
